caption:
✍️ Semicolons in big lists

✅ Rule: When list items have commas inside, separate items with semicolons.
❌ She visited Austin, Texas, Denver, Colorado, and Reno, Nevada.
✅ She visited Austin, Texas; Denver, Colorado; and Reno, Nevada.
✅ Quick check: Commas inside items → semicolons between items.
